info.name: SAT Datashare — Exp / PAPI / SAPI
info.description:
One collection. All variables are on the collection.

Folders: Eapi / PAPI / SAPI, each with local, sandbox, presandbox, production.

Eapi sandbox, presandbox, and production each have Get Azure Token.
Exp: Authorization Bearer {{access_token}} only. No database or supplier.
PAPI: Authorization: Test (hardcoded). Send database and supplier.
SAPI: no Authorization header. Send database and supplier.
